evaluation_policy.folds: Keep the existing SHA/group outer folds unchanged. Re-run all compared models after reviewed annotations are versioned; obtain new filming sessions/camera footage for a locked independent test.
evaluation_policy.point_metrics_now: One-to-one maximum-cardinality recall at +/-1, +/-2, +/-5 seconds. Missed points count against recall; timing median/p90 are conditional diagnostics.
evaluation_policy.positive_windows: Unmarked positive-video spans remain unlabeled. Suggested review windows are navigation aids, never inferred event intervals.
evaluation_policy.negative_windows: Preserve provided negative labels. Ask a reviewer to confirm exhaustive normality before treating every negative-video window as a trusted background/action negative in revised training.
evaluation_policy.boundary_events: Review events near a video edge for visibility and censoring; mark unknown/unobservable portions instead of inventing normal labels.
evaluation_policy.review_queue: Error counts are human-review priorities only; do not auto-relabel, invert model scores, add filename/duration features or move difficult videos between folds.
evaluation_policy.model_scores: Scores from different models/folds are uncalibrated; do not average them as annotation confidence.
